name: Gowalla
description: A user–item implicit-feedback dataset derived from Gowalla users' check-in activity, commonly used to evaluate recommendation algorithms. This record describes the dataset only and does not distribute its data.
citation: Liang, D., Krishnan, R. G., Hoffman, M. D., & Jebara, T. (2018). Variational Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering. Proceedings of the 2018 World Wide Web Conference, 689–698. https://doi.org/10.1145/3178876.3186150

license.notes: The dataset is distributed under dataset-specific terms, not a standard SPDX identifier. Review the upstream repository and original data terms before use or redistribution; this record vendors no data.
